body:
Raised and independently reproduced 2026-10-07 America/Los_Angeles by post-merge Auditor `01a10892-0782-7b13-902c-d8b4db6c155d`.

Affected PR #1140, merge `09c2dcff4f5acd92936fdd49378dd563332a1187`, head `07c74844f21f452eb7b202e450b19a4755f62c43`. Preserve closed #910/#454 and original #919 packet/quality findings. This is one additive exact15-subject evidence integrity correction; no current source adjudication, boundary/hierarchy edits, imports or publication.

Confirmed problems in `data/regional-review/fiji-admin-source-reconciliation-20261005/`:
1. The source-vintage explanation ignores the release metadata's actual `boundaryYear:"2020"` while asserting null represented year. `boundaryYearRepresented` is absent in that release record, not a JSON null. The accompanying citation defines `boundaryYear` as representative year(s). Current API uses `boundaryYearRepresented:"2020"`; both records omit a sha256 field. Report the actual keys/values/absence without resolving the separate2007 linked-census reference versus2020 catalog interpretation by assumption. `source-provenance.json` also records nonexistent GeoJSON Git blob `a55fc77ef79cfc65cfbcbaf1036d9832d57c5beb` (authenticated request404); the actual pinned blob is `a55fc77ef79cfc65ea2bbaf1036d9832d57c5beb`. Its LFS OID correctly matches retained payload SHA256 `a9cd94789cb5eb66cfbcbaf32a21bcbceba16b9a76adacba9ac675b950ca1ccd`,1357011B. The declared root `CITATION-AND-USE.txt` URL404s; actual source is `releaseData/gbOpen/FJI/ADM2/CITATION-AND-USE-geoBoundaries.txt` at9469f09592ced973a3448cf66b6100b741b64c0d, Git blob `ff1d1d9a4ab9c714a5a60eca051696f41446a086`, LFS OID `f6ea7572bea6036c4cdcacf8c0ca7bf09098d4e600d19546d7432533e9a290d5`,4316B. Metadata blob `8a798505b2cfd83546e8fcc9a59b5643be60987b` correctly authenticates970B payload SHA2a518d79ff779e3dddd3cfabd0357885c078e7226fdeceb0ddc3e10d47d31925. Wrong restoration identities and omitted year evidence prevent a faithful source-chain report; actual retained payload hashes themselves match.
2. Actual `reproduce.py --output` unconditionally replaces an existing output via `write_text`. Against an owned private sentinel under the packet, actual unchanged main exits0 and replaces it with the retained result. Default documented run-one/run-two paths already exist historically. The out-of-owned-path control is correctly rejected, but that does not preserve existing results inside ownership.
3. Actual `build_packet.py` writes `outcome:"passed"` unconditionally for pair reproducibility, even if `byte_identical:false` and both run hashes differ. In a complete private packet fixture changing only second-run Lau jaccard to0.123456789, the unchanged builder exits0 and emits passed with false byte-identical/different hashes, then publishes the manifest. The valid actual pair also passes. False equality is honestly recorded, but the overall success assertion is wrong.
4. Actual builder removes every immediate file under `scratch` and deletes the directory before building evidence, with no preservation. In both valid/mismatched private fixtures an owned failed-attempt sentinel is deleted. The Auditor preserved its exact bytes separately before the test and did not expose any historical/foreign file. Generation must not erase earlier evidence merely because it is stored in scratch.
5. The two reported negative controls are Boolean checks that an invented ID is not present and a real source name differs from a dummy string. They do not submit corrupt scope/name/source data to the crosswalk/rejection path. Retained negative-controls.json therefore cannot substantiate the stated wrong-name/absent-source rejection claim. This is missing nonvacuous proof; no allegation that the committed names are wrong or that an actual mismatched source currently bypasses its whole-source hash guard.

Actual verification: all16 added whole files1484385B/head-merge equal,20 baseline/source/output descriptors and8 metric bindings match. Independently checked all15native suffix/name/parent mappings and165 fields, source Lau91components/5887vertices, using independent world-seam handling and WGS84 strip antiderivative with32point quadrature (original uses16point centered integration). Allfive Lau values agree, maximum relative error2.26e-13; IoU0.7687948822374 and symmetric difference120.36379001875km² are diagnostic divergence, not legal correctness. Actual managed sparse exact-merge producer CLIs twice yield whole result byte-identical to each other and retained originals; existing private output is replaced and outside-owned path is rejected. Shared helper code/side effects were inspected before execution. Cached Python3.12.14/Shapely2.1.2/pyproj3.7.2/GEOS3.13.1, bytecode disabled, storage gates, no installation/import.

Actual builder fixtures use a reviewed root-discovery-only adapter: only resolving the original builder's own file path redirects its root to a complete private packet copy. Its real code, comparison, deletion, writing and baseline Git reads remain unchanged; private fixture remains within the managed Git checkout. All changed run bytes and deleted private sentinels are preserved. Authenticated GitHub pinned Contents/Git Blob APIs independently confirm allthree LFS OIDs, actual metadata/GeoJSON/citation identities and404 mismatches; no live geoboundaries/official-site or source-license approval is implied.

Success criteria:
- One fresh additive erratum under the disjoint owned namespace; preserve exact15IDs, all original source/geometry/parents/names, code, dates, results and closed issue histories.
- Derive provenance from actual retained/authenticated fields: distinguish absent fields from null; include release boundaryYear2020/currentAPI represented-year2020 and the linked2007 source reference, authentic blob identities and working immutable citation restoration path. Keep vintage meaning and registry digest recipe unresolved unless actual supporting evidence establishes them. Do not promote uninspected primary pages/PDFs to independently verified authority.
- Actual producer/builder must admit a complete fresh output namespace before writing; reject existing files/directories/broken symlinks/path escapes and preserve all earlier/failed evidence. Remove automatic scratch destruction; explicitly preserve and identify any owned temporary cleanup. Exercise actual adjacent conflict/default/existing-sentinel cases.
- Require two independently executed successful complete runs, exact actual consumed source/code/scope/identity pins and whole-product equality before a passed pair receipt/manifest. Actual mismatched/missing/failed/copied-run controls must fail without publishing successful evidence or changing previous results. Retain failed runs and truthful limits.
- Replace negative proof with actual complete corrupt-ID/name/source fixtures submitted to rejection paths; include independently derived positive15subject/identity/parent and Lau controls. Do not use dummy-string inequality as proof of rejection.
- Preserve the original15 subject classifications and scientifically correct Lau numerical result, with justified tolerance; version1 whole-file manifest, truthful metric/control/run bindings, per-file receipts and independent exact-head review.

Limits/dependencies: empty dependencies because bounded mechanical/provenance inputs are available and preserved. Original910 allows explicit unavailable source/authority/completeness outcomes. The actual unretained2017 census material and2024 Rotuma Hansard bodies have not been independently authenticated by this Auditor under GitHub-only access; their legal/statistical assertions remain a separate original-audit unchecked scope. No new authoritative boundary selection, Rotuma ontology implementation, SALB comparison, island-completeness or legal approval is required for this erratum. Qualify unsupported verified-source claims honestly.

Deduplication: complete all-state14 pages [100×13,60]/943 non-PR issues and later affected-packet Git history find no matching repair. Closed910 is the completed source research handoff; closed1107 corrects different #919 roster/child coverage. #1293 owns shared dateline preparation and source-topology validation, not these reporting/control/preservation programs. #1141 concerns South Atlantic source/control files. New namespace disjoint; maximum one PR; shared readiness must review live scope/dependencies/ownership before Ready.
